chapters.title: The Sealed Lamp and the Road Home
warnings: fluency-02: output near-identical to base — copied, not re-voiced
editorial_queries: The source is a first-person expository commentary ("So I begin," "I want you to see"); the third-person frame was honored by rendering the narrator's exposition impersonally while keeping the collective "we/our" that denotes humankind, but whether that collective voice should likewise be neutralized is unclear.
comprehension_flags: A general reader may stumble on the doctrinal terms *Qaim*, *hudud*, *Awliya Allah*, and *Imams*, which the passage invokes without definition.
terminology_notes: *Suradiq* — should be fixed book-wide against the variant *Sardaq* that the source itself flags.
